text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat on the day at modest gains, suggesting consolidation rather than directional conviction. The Fear & Greed index sitting at 30 indicates genuine market apprehension, with dominance holding steady near 57%, pointing to a risk-off mood where traders are parking capital in the largest assets rather than rotating into alts. Volume at $37B is moderate, typical of a period without catalysts—neither capitulation nor euphoria is evident.
